subject: Deal-led GPU runway & risk triage
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Deal-led GPU runway & risk triage

Team — attaching the capacity request that came in from Acme for the pilot they want to start mid-Apr. Key items: estimated concurrent sessions ~45, 1.2M tokens/day peak, burst windows during business hours. They want a committed Dedicated pool for predictable latency through the pilot.

Ask: can infra confirm whether we have a 90-day runway for a medium pool (4x A40 equiv nodes) starting 2027-04-10? Finance: what minimum commit size do we need to offer so margins are acceptable for a pilot-priced deal? Sales: can you confirm the ACV/commit expectations and whether they'll sign a 3-month pilot?

Attachments: ACME_capacity_request.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Short note on risk: our current unallocated dedicated capacity is limited in US-west; if multiple pilots land in the same window we need to either 1) shift to Dedicated burst (higher cost) or 2) propose mixed Dedicated + Hosted fallback.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Deal-led GPU runway & risk triage

Thanks Ben — pulled the sheet. Two quick asks before we align a recommendation: 

- Jordan: need an outline of acceptable commit sizes and comfort on pilot pricing (do we need a minimum 3-month commit at $X/mo or can we accept month-to-month with higher unit rates?).
- Karthik/Laura: can infra show a worst-case contention scenario if another medium pilot (TessCorp) starts Apr 5? Specifically: can we map node allocation under priority policy and show expected latency delta at 95th pct?

I'll loop in Acme if we have a clear runway + proposal to share.

-Stephanie Nguyen
Head of GTM Ops (covering Sales-Finance-Infra sync)
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Deal-led GPU runway & risk triage

Stephanie — quick finance view attached (RW_reserve_runway_v2.csv). Short version: we need a 3-month reserved commit for a medium pool to hit target margin @ pilot pricing. Numbers:
- Pilot list price (dedicated medium pool): $48k/month
- Target discounted pilot price we can offer w/o loss: $36k/month with 3-month commit
- If customer insists on month-to-month, unit economics drops ~22% (requires a higher price or credits).

Recommendations: offer 3-month pilot at $36k/mo with an agreed evaluation SLA + metrics (latency P95, token throughput). If infra flags runway risk, consider a hybrid where we guarantee baseline Dedicated capacity for business hours and use Hosted fallback for non-critical batch workloads.

Attachment: RW_reserve_runway_v2.csv

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Finance Manager, Revenue
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <acme-procurement@acme.com>
Cc: CloudScale POC <cloudscale-poc@cloudscale.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Deal-led GPU runway & risk triage

Hi all — looping in Acme procurement and our CloudScale partner for capacity confirmation. Ben here from Sales. Summary of internal alignment so you have context: 

- Finance (Jordan): recommends 3-month committed pilot at $36k/month to keep pricing attractive and protect margins.
- Infra (Karthik/Laura): can provision a medium Dedicated pool for Apr 10 start if we avoid overlapping TessCorp window (Apr 5–18). If overlap occurs, we will propose: baseline Dedicated during 9–18 PT and Hosted fallback for off-peak batch processing. Expect slight P95 latency adder (~15–25ms) in overlap scenario.

Acme — can you confirm: 1) willingness to a 3-month committed pilot? 2) firm target start date (you had mid-Apr in the LOI)? If you prefer month-to-month, we can still run but pricing would shift.

Proposed next step: I can send a short Mutual Action Plan and the 3-month pilot SOW to speed approvals. Attached: ACME_capacity_request.xlsx (original ask).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Acme Procurement <acme-procurement@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 12:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Deal-led GPU runway & risk triage

Thanks Ben — Acme procurement here. We confirm intent to run the pilot and prefer a committed 3-month window that aligns with our internal evaluation period. Target start is Apr 12 (gives our infra team two weeks to configure).

Two asks before we sign: 
1) Provide a short SOW and the pilot SLA (P95 latency target, retention of logs) we can attach to our procurement packet.
2) A redline-friendly contract (DocuSign link preferred) — we will aim to turn around within 5 business days once we have SOW + pricing.

If there's a contingency plan for capacity overlap with other pilots, please include the fallback behavior and any potential performance deltas in writing.

Best,
Alex Marin
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
